subject: Re: Request to share a local heritage records call with members in Leckwith and Penarth Road
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Hi Requester

Thanks for getting in touch and sharing your research with us. Unfortunately, we don't do bulletins or social posts that would really fit with what you're looking for. Our member communications approach is quite tightly held and largely driven from our headquarters in Blackpool.

I hope the search goes well though - it's a part of Cardiff I know fairly well, mainly from picking up post in the post office depot or trips down to the pumping station.

Kind regards
Josh


________________________________
From: Requester <[email redacted]>
Sent: Monday, November 02, 2026 22:49
To: Wales <[email redacted]>
Subject: Request to share a local heritage records call with members in Leckwith and Penarth Road

Dear FSB Wales,

I am researching the history of Great House Farm (Tŷ Mawr),
Llandough-juxta-Penarth, a holding between Llandough and Leckwith.
Much of today's Leckwith industrial and commercial area, and the
Penarth Road and Ferry Road corridor, stands on what was farmland and
marsh of the old parish of Leckwith.

Small firms that have been on those sites for decades sometimes keep
old title deeds, site plans, surveys and photographs that no archive
holds. Would FSB Wales be willing to mention, in a regional bulletin
or social post, a short call for businesses in Leckwith, Penarth Road,
Ferry Road or Llandough that hold such material from before the 1990s,
or simply remember the area, to get in touch? I would supply the
wording for your approval, and anything shared would be credited or
kept private as the business prefers.

Thank you for considering this.

Kind regards,

Requester 
Royal Signals Cyber/ Electronic Warfare Professional
bucklerfamily.estate
